correctness.rationale: For printed 4D flow xdot=a*y, wdot=y and a !=0, d(w-x/a)/dt = y-(1/a)(a*y)=0 exactly; changing coordinates K=w-x/a leaves Kdot=0 and induces identity quotient cocycle over three-dimensional invariant leaves. With ε>0 no equilibria since xdot=0 implies y=0 and then zdot=ε>0. On compact invariant support X is bounded and bounded away from zero, so Dφ_t X(p)=X(φ_t p) gives a zero exponent tangent to leaf. Exact constant quotient cocycle supplies a second zero exponent (multiplicity counted via block-triangular Lyapunov spectrum). Stationarity applied to z gives integral y² dμ=ε. Thus 4D Lyapunov sum negative implies at most one strictly positive exponent; cannot conclude for nonnegative sums. At a=1/20 both published initial points have K=-2 by direct evaluation. These are infinite-time structural identities, not claims from numerical Lyapunov plots.
